name: Jacob Robinson
description: At PLACE19 in 2019, Jacob Robinson of Massey University described developing GIS capability for Te Awa Tupua. His abstract includes assembling geospatial data, georeferencing historical maps and extracting place names, with community environmental monitoring among the project’s aims.
